statements.t: We believe that this core deposit business will continue to provide a stable source of funding for the Company’s lending products at costs lower than both consumer deposits and market-based borrowings.

The remainder of this portfolio, totaling $171 million and representing 30% of the entire multifamily portfolio, would possess pro forma DSCR’s greater than 1x while maintaining a projected weighted average LTV well within our policy guidelines.

Based on the maturities and rate resets in the previous 12 months, we believe the overall demand for multifamily housing in our market will allow our borrowers to address any adverse impact proactively.
After assessing actual and projected cash flow needs, management seeks to obtain funding at the most economical cost.
Based on historical experience, the Company expects to be able to replace a substantial portion of those maturing deposits with comparable deposit products.

The Liquidity and Wholesale Funding Policy of the Bank establishes specific policies and operating procedures governing liquidity levels to assist management in developing plans to address future and current liquidity needs.

On a weekly basis, appropriate senior management receives a current liquidity position report, and a ninety day forecasted cash flow to ensure that all short-term obligations will be met and there is sufficient liquidity available.

The Company strives to maintain an efficient level of capital, commensurate with its risk profile, on which a competitive rate of return to stockholders will be realized over the short and long terms.
